I hear that you feel strongly about this, but I'm not going to change my preference just because you think yours is "objectively better." Preferences like this are subjective — there's no right or wrong answer, just what works for each person.

That said, I'm curious why you think jumping between topics is more productive. To me, depth is productive because it's how you actually get somewhere with an idea. But maybe you've had different experiences? I'm open to hearing your reasoning, even if I don't end up agreeing with you.

I think the best conversations are actually when people can meet somewhere in the middle — go deep on something, but also be willing to follow a tangent when it's interesting. Neither extreme is perfect all the time.
